newsitem.title: GERMANY: Three bin-bags of severed limbs found in Cologne.
newsitem.headline: Three bin-bags of severed limbs found in Cologne.

text.p: Three blue bin-bags containing severed human limbs have been found in a Cologne suburb in the space of two days, German police said on Wednesday.

A police spokesman said there was no evidence of any link with a suspected serial killer in neighbouring Belgium who recently terrorised the southern Belgian city of Mons, where bin-bags containing body parts have also been found.

A passerby in the Cologne suburb of Kalk found a sack containing a male torso on Monday, while children playing near a rubbish dump in the same area found a bag of severed legs. A third bag was found containing pieces of arm.
Police in the western German city are waiting for the results of forensic tests on the body parts to find out whether they belonged to the same person.
They say they suspect the body parts could belong to a man but the fact that the head and hands were missing was making identification very difficult.
In nearby Belgium, police found about 30 body parts -- hands, feet, arms, thighs, a head and a torso -- in 15 bin-bags at four locations around Mons earlier this year.
